For the generated technical specification, the decomposition considered the header definition, combinational logic, and timing aspects of the counter. spec_atomic_units: Module top_module(input clk, input reset, output reg [9:0] q)
Clock input (clk)
Synchronous active-high reset input (reset)
10-bit output register (q)
Output q changes on rising edge of clk
If reset is high at rising edge of clk, q resets to 0
If reset is low at rising edge of clk, q increments
Counter wraps around from 999 to 0
Next value of q depends on current q, reset, and clk
Reset signal setup time must be met
Reset signal hold time must be met
Counter increments if reset is low
Counter resets to 0 if reset is high
Counter counts from 0 to 999
Period is 1000 clock cycles
Combinational logic determines next state of counter
If reset is asserted, q is forced to 0
If reset is not asserted, q is incremented by 1
If q is 999 and reset is not asserted, q resets to 0
Combinational logic uses comparators, adder, and multiplexer
Reset logic: When reset is high, q is set to 0
Increment logic: When reset is low, q is incremented by 1
Wrap-Around Logic: If q is equal to 999, the next value of q should be 0
Multiplexing Logic: Selects between 0, q + 1, based on reset and comparator output
